game_title: Examination practice · Branch Assembly 1 · Separate Outputs
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Week 5 examination practice: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 16. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Deliver exactly 14 components (7 upper, 7 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 14.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.

Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the palm grove using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 14.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the palm grove is reached, or lives reach 0.

hint: Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Branch contracts: A: 7 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_upper; B: 7 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_lower. Power the junctions and production machines.
